items.title: Historic Old Town Square
items.description: The heart of the city’s history, Old Town Square features cobblestone streets, centuries-old architecture, street performers, and charming cafés. It’s the perfect starting point to understand the city’s cultural roots and vibrant daily life.

items.title: Riverside Promenade Park
items.description: A scenic walking and cycling path along the river, offering skyline views, public art installations, and sunset photo spots. Ideal for a relaxed afternoon stroll or morning jog.

items.title: Metropolitan Art Museum
items.description: Home to both classical masterpieces and contemporary exhibitions, this museum showcases local and international artists. Guided tours and interactive exhibits make it engaging for all visitors.

items.title: Skyline Observation Tower
items.description: For panoramic city views, the observation deck provides a 360-degree perspective from above. Visit at sunset to watch the city lights come alive.

items.title: Central Market Hall
items.description: A bustling indoor market filled with local vendors selling fresh produce, street food, handmade crafts, and regional delicacies. A must-visit for food lovers wanting authentic flavors.

items.title: Botanical Garden Conservatory
items.description: A tranquil escape featuring themed gardens, exotic plants, and seasonal floral displays. It’s a peaceful retreat from the city’s busy streets.

items.title: Harborfront Cultural Center
items.description: This waterfront venue hosts live music, theater performances, and art festivals throughout the year. A great place to experience the city’s creative scene.

items.title: Historic Grand Theater
items.description: An architectural gem offering concerts, ballet, and classic film screenings. Even if you don’t attend a show, the guided interior tours reveal stunning design details and rich history.
